$comment: MIGRATING_COMPATIBILITY: implemented v0 AI runtime projection; new code uses generic runtime profiles and Product-owned manifests.
title: RuntimeManifest
description: The fully resolved runtime environment for a workload. Its `runtime_id` is a content hash of the manifest with the `runtime_id` field itself excluded (see schemas/CANONICALIZATION.md).

runtime_id.description: Computed content id, format 'sha256:<hex>'. EXCLUDED from the canonical hash preimage; treat as output only.

workload.description: Kind of workload this runtime serves.

hardware_profile.description: Compact hardware profile the runtime is resolved against (subset of HardwareManifest).

gpu_count.description: Number of GPUs the runtime targets.

cuda_max_supported.description: Maximum CUDA runtime the driver supports, e.g. '12.4'.

cuda_runtime.description: CUDA runtime version bundled in the image, e.g. '12.4.1'.

frameworks.description: Additional framework versions keyed by package name, e.g. {'transformers': '4.44.2'}.

training_strategy.description: Training/serving strategy, e.g. 'full', 'lora', 'qlora', or 'none' for pure serving.

base_image_digest.description: Digest of the base container image, format 'sha256:<hex>'.

validation_level.description: Highest validation level reached for this runtime.
